title: Story premise EDU039: The Note With a Broken Tether
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: Where did this sentence come from? Takeaway/theme: Useful research notes preserve a path back to supporting evidence.
description: A researcher wants to reuse a striking claim, but its note has lost the original source and surrounding context. Reattaching a citation card and checking the passage distinguishes support from speculation.
